name: Further Instructions
summary: Ziz Fizziks sends stolen Venture Company plans from Windshear Crag to Ratchet. The documents may give his rival Sputtervalve an edge.

sections.title: Corporate Espionage
sections.body: After the Venture Company cast Ziz Fizziks out of its logging operations at Windshear Crag, he took sensitive documents, internal manuals, and technical schematics with him. Bitter over his dismissal, he sealed them in an envelope bound for Ratchet. Among the papers are blueprints for the experimental Super Reaper 6000. Fizziks hopes to find a buyer or ally willing to use what he stole.

sections.title: The Ratchet Connection
sections.body: Sputtervalve, an engineer, waits in the neutral port of Ratchet in the Barrens. He has little affection or trust for Fizziks, but the rivalry with the Venture Company makes the offer hard to refuse. The Steamwheedle-aligned goblins seek ways to weaken their ruthless competitor and eagerly reverse-engineer superior mechanical inventions they encounter.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope holds Venture Company documents, technical manuals, and blueprints for the Super Reaper 6000. Ziz Fizziks stole them when he was driven from the company's logging operation.
Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer in Ratchet, in the Barrens. He distrusts Ziz Fizziks, but wants to weaken the Venture Company and study its machines.

faq.q: Why is Ziz Fizziks working against the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company drove Fizziks from its ranks in Stonetalon. Bitter and seeking revenge, he began passing its trade secrets to rivals.
Sputtervalve is in Ratchet, a neutral port town on the eastern coast of the Barrens.
No. Sputtervalve admits he distrusts Fizziks, but the manuals and blueprints are worth more to him than his wariness of the messenger.
The Super Reaper 6000 is an advanced industrial shredder the Venture Company developed to clear forests and process lumber quickly. Its blueprints are highly coveted.

angles.text: The envelope carries the marks of goblin industry: corporate espionage, patent theft, and reverse-engineering complex lumber harvesters.
Carrying stolen Venture Company plans to Ratchet feeds trade rivalries that challenge industrial expansion near Horde territory.
